name: Tunnel Wash

features.text: Will not leave streaks when used properly
Designed to be used in proportioning system

description: A thin, orange liquid with a soapy aroma. It is an economical, concentrated shampoo that produces a rich, long-lasting foam for use on vehicles, trailers, boats, or motor homes. This product is thin enough to be used through proportioning systems and car-wash tunnels
application: Machine Use: Set proportioning or tunnel system to desired dilution setting. Place pickup hose in drum. Operate equipment according to manufacturer’s directions. Hand Use: Use 1 part concentrate for 100 parts waters (approximately 2 oz. for each 1 gallon of water). Adjust dilution to desired strength for extremely dirty conditions. Rinse vehicle thoroughly. Apply solution generously, using a mitt. Rinse well. Wipe dry with a clean chamois. For best results, surface should be cool and out of direct sunlight.
